name: Vertex-Centric Summation Disguise
description: Shifted the validation condition from a global product over edges to a local sum over the neighborhood of each vertex. The new condition requires that for each vertex, the sum of its neighbors' values plus its degree times its own value equals 3 times its degree. This completely removes the prime factorization and per-edge polynomial affordances, forcing models to algebraically deduce that the local maximum/minimum strictly constrains all neighbors to have the opposite value.
